ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio characterized by a dominant low-intensity (black) surface punctuated by approximately 8-12% high-intensity (white) pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distal tips exhibit dense, irregular high-intensity white clusters; the primary lobe surfaces contain numerous discrete annular and circular white pixel formations scattered across the dark background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 50-60 degrees relative to the medial axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge shows irregular serrations with frequent peaks and valleys; amplitude is most distinct on the upper margin of the right lobe against the blue water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe exhibits a continuous convex sweep on its outer margin; the right lobe displays a jagged, generally convex trailing edge profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive detection of white, ring-shaped pixel clusters (annular rosettes) of varying radii distributed across both the left and right ventral lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of high-intensity white calcified masses at the terminal tips of both lobes; extensive circular scarring across the visible dark ventral surface.
